import base64
import calendar
import json
import time
from urllib.parse import quote

import pytest

from youtube_dl.extractor.fourtube import PornTubeIE
from youtube_dl.utils import unified_timestamp


def _make_initial_state(video):
    payload = json.dumps({'page': {'video': video}})
    # base64 may contain '+'/'='; URL-quote it so the extractor's
    # compat_urllib_parse_unquote step is genuinely exercised.
    return quote(base64.b64encode(payload.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii'), safe='')


def _make_webpage(video):
    return '<html><script>INITIALSTATE = "%s";</script></html>' % _make_initial_state(video)


def _install_mocks(monkeypatch, webpage, formats_result):
    calls = {}

    def fake_download_webpage(self, url, *args, **kwargs):
        calls['webpage_url'] = url
        calls['display_id'] = args[0] if args else kwargs.get('video_id')
        return webpage

    def fake_extract_formats(self, url, video_id, media_id, sources):
        calls['formats_args'] = (url, video_id, media_id, list(sources))
        return formats_result

    monkeypatch.setattr(PornTubeIE, '_download_webpage', fake_download_webpage)
    monkeypatch.setattr(PornTubeIE, '_extract_formats', fake_extract_formats)
    return calls


def test_porn_tube_real_extract_full(monkeypatch):
    video = {
        'title': 'Test video',
        'mediaId': 12345,
        'encodings': [{'height': 720}, {'height': 1080}, {'other': 1}],
        'masterThumb': 'https://img.porntube.com/thumb.jpg',
        'user': {'username': 'someuser', 'id': 42},
        'channel': {'name': 'Some Channel', 'id': 7},
        'likes': 10,
        'dislikes': 2,
        'playsQty': 1000,
        'durationInSeconds': 300,
        'publishedAt': '2015-06-06T12:00:00+00:00',
    }
    formats_result = [{'ext': 'mp4', 'height': 720}, {'ext': 'mp4', 'height': 1080}]
    calls = _install_mocks(monkeypatch, _make_webpage(video), formats_result)

    ie = PornTubeIE()
    url = 'https://www.porntube.com/videos/teen-couple-doing-anal_7089759'
    info = ie._real_extract(url)

    # _download_webpage and _extract_formats were invoked correctly
    assert calls['webpage_url'] == url
    assert calls['display_id'] == 'teen-couple-doing-anal'
    assert calls['formats_args'] == (
        url, '7089759', 12345, ['720', '1080'])

    assert info['id'] == '7089759'
    assert info['title'] == 'Test video'
    assert info['formats'] == formats_result
    assert info['thumbnail'] == 'https://img.porntube.com/thumb.jpg'
    # uploader present -> wins over channel
    assert info['uploader'] == 'someuser'
    assert info['uploader_id'] == '42'
    assert info['channel'] == 'Some Channel'
    assert info['channel_id'] == '7'
    expected_ts = calendar.timegm(time.strptime(
        '2015-06-06T12:00:00+00:00', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00'))
    assert info['timestamp'] == expected_ts
    assert info['like_count'] == 10
    assert info['dislike_count'] == 2
    assert info['view_count'] == 1000
    assert info['duration'] == 300
    assert info['age_limit'] == 18


def test_porn_tube_real_extract_fallbacks_and_missing_fields(monkeypatch):
    # No user/channel, invalid thumb URL, missing counts -> fallback/None paths
    video = {
        'title': 'Fallback video',
        'mediaId': 999,
        'encodings': [{'height': 360}],
        'masterThumb': 'not a url',
        'publishedAt': 'garbage-timestamp',
    }
    formats_result = [{'ext': 'mp4', 'height': 360}]
    calls = _install_mocks(monkeypatch, _make_webpage(video), formats_result)

    ie = PornTubeIE()
    url = 'https://www.porntube.com/videos/fallback-video_111'
    info = ie._real_extract(url)

    assert calls['formats_args'][1] == '111'
    assert calls['formats_args'][2] == 999
    assert calls['formats_args'][3] == ['360']

    assert info['id'] == '111'
    assert info['title'] == 'Fallback video'
    assert info['formats'] == formats_result
    assert info['thumbnail'] is None
    assert info['uploader'] is None
    assert info['uploader_id'] is None
    assert info['channel'] is None
    assert info['channel_id'] is None
    assert info['timestamp'] is None
    assert info['like_count'] is None
    assert info['dislike_count'] is None
    assert info['view_count'] is None
    assert info['duration'] is None
    assert info['age_limit'] == 18


def test_porn_tube_real_extract_embed_url(monkeypatch):
    # Embed URL variant: display_id group is absent (None)
    video = {
        'title': 'Embed video',
        'mediaId': 555,
        'encodings': [{'height': 480}],
    }
    formats_result = [{'ext': 'mp4', 'height': 480}]
    calls = _install_mocks(monkeypatch, _make_webpage(video), formats_result)

    ie = PornTubeIE()
    url = 'https://www.porntube.com/embed/7089759'
    info = ie._real_extract(url)

    assert calls['display_id'] is None
    assert calls['formats_args'] == (url, '7089759', 555, ['480'])
    assert info['id'] == '7089759'
    assert info['title'] == 'Embed video'
    assert info['formats'] == formats_result
    assert info['age_limit'] == 18

def _make_initial_state(video):
    payload = json.dumps({'page': {'video': video}})
    # base64 may contain '+'/'='; URL-quote it so the extractor's
    # compat_urllib_parse_unquote step is genuinely exercised.
    return quote(base64.b64encode(payload.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii'), safe='')

    def fake_download_webpage(self, url, *args, **kwargs):
        calls['webpage_url'] = url
        calls['display_id'] = args[0] if args else kwargs.get('video_id')
        return webpage

    def fake_extract_formats(self, url, video_id, media_id, sources):
        calls['formats_args'] = (url, video_id, media_id, list(sources))
        return formats_result

    """YoutubeDL class.

    YoutubeDL objects are the ones responsible of downloading the
    actual video file and writing it to disk if the user has requested

    For this, YoutubeDL objects have a method that allows

        # Shadow the class attribute on the instance only, so no class-level
        # state is polluted; the instance is discarded after the test.
        ie._TKN_HOST = 'token.example.com'

    def test_extract_formats_builds_token_url_and_sorted_formats(self, monkeypatch):
        ie = self._make_ie()
        sources = ['720', '240', '1080']  # deliberately unsorted input
        tokens_json = {
            '240': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.m3u8'},
            '720': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.m3u8'},
            '1080': {'token': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.m3u8'},
        }
        captured = {}

        def fake_download_json(token_url, video_id, data=b'', headers=None):
            captured['token_url'] = token_url
            captured['video_id'] = video_id
            captured['data'] = data
            captured['headers'] = headers
            return tokens_json

        monkeypatch.setattr(ie, '_download_json', fake_download_json)

        url = 'https://www.fourtube.com/videos/some-video'
        formats = ie._extract_formats(url, 'vid123', 'media456', sources)

        # Line 26-27: token URL built from _TKN_HOST, media_id and joined sources
        assert captured['token_url'] == (
            'https://token.example.com/media456/desktop/720+240+1080')
        # Line 30: _download_json called with the right video_id and empty body
        assert captured['video_id'] == 'vid123'
        assert captured['data'] == b''
        # Lines 31-32: Origin derived from url scheme/hostname, Referer is url
        assert captured['headers']['Origin'] == 'https://www.fourtube.com'
        assert captured['headers']['Referer'] == url
        # Lines 34-39: one format entry per source, with correct fields
        assert len(formats) == 3
        by_id = {f['format_id']: f for f in formats}
        for src in sources:
            entry = by_id[src + 'p']
            assert entry['url'] == tokens_json[src]['token']
            assert entry['resolution'] == src + 'p'
            assert entry['quality'] == int(src)
        # Line 40: _sort_formats ran -> formats sorted ascending by quality
        qualities = [f['quality'] for f in formats]
        assert qualities == sorted(qualities)
        # Line 41: the (sorted) formats list is returned
        assert formats == [
            {'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/240.m3u8',
             'format_id': '240p', 'resolution': '240p', 'quality': 240},
            {'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/720.m3u8',
             'format_id': '720p', 'resolution': '720p', 'quality': 720},
            {'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080.m3u8',
